_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Custom Microcircuit Characterization Report
summary: The Custom Microcircuit Characterization Report documents the data to be supplied in support of the characterization requirements for custom integrated circuits and hybrid microcircuits.
description_purpose: 3.1 This report documents the data to be supplied in support of the requirements for the characterization of both custom integrated circuits and hybrid microcircuits.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.2 The term microcircuit or custom microcircuit, as used in this data item description, shall refer to both custom integrated circuits and hybrid microcircuits.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan may be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Title Page.
children.content: The title page for the characterization report shall contain:

children.title: Custom Microcircuits covered by the report
Schmoo Plots.
children.content: Schmoo plots shall be generated to chart the device operating region with respect to the following parameters at the devices specified lower temperature limit, 25 degree centigrade, and specified upper temperature limit. A minimum of 10 points along each parameter shall be chosen. Four points shall be in the specified operating region, such that the area will contain a total of 16 data points. Sample size shall be indicated. Data points which indicate failures shall be identified with a different character than those points which do not indicate failures.

children.title: Clock pulse width (duty cycle vs. clock voltage)
Discussion Section.
children.content: This section shall describe the test setup and point out any important details and problems encountered.

children.title: Conclusion.
children.content: The conclusion section shall give the contractor's final judgment as to whether the data presented has shown that the parts meet the specified operating requirements.
